notes:
'request' describes the raw HTTP bytes via RemoteAPITestSupport.rawRequest's own algorithm (RemoteAPITestSupport.swift): '<method> <target> HTTP/1.1
' + each header as '<Key>: <Value>
' (order doesn't affect parsing — Swift dictionary iteration is unordered and the parser doesn't care) + a blank '
' line + the body bytes appended verbatim. 'trailingBytes' is appended raw after the fully-built request (headers+body), simulating a pipelined second request whose bytes haven't been consumed yet — they must surface as remainingData, not be silently dropped.
